episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.summary: Six years after murdering his parents, Sergio gets released from juvenile detention and becomes the subject of Ana's secret investigation.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.summary: Marta puts her relationship with Eneko at risk by getting closer to Sergio, who opens up about life before the death of his parents.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.summary: Sergio returns to the detention center and has an unexpected encounter there. Thanks to Marta, Ana discovers information that may turn the case around.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.summary: When the investigation wavers, Ana discovers that she and Sergio share more in common than she thought. A determined Sergio tries to find his sister Noa.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.summary: Pressure from Cabrera forces both Sergio and Greta to make desperate moves. Eneko tries to reconcile with Marta. The case threatens Ana's personal life.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.summary: Ana turns up at Sergio's house, and he insists on meeting Noa. The police try to close the case for good while a leak exposes Cabrera's methods.
